title: Dermatologist Approaches to Biologic Therapy in Moderate-to-Severe Plaque Psoriasis
intro: Thank you for participating. This survey takes approximately 8 minutes. Your responses are confidential and reported only in aggregate.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes your primary professional role?
How many years have you been in clinical practice?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 50.

questions.text: How many patients with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis do you personally manage in a typical month?
questions.instruction: Enter a whole number between 0 and 500.

questions.text: Do you currently prescribe biologic therapies for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?
Which of the following biologic therapies do you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?
Overall, how satisfied are you with the biologic therapies you currently prescribe for moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?
What is the single biggest barrier to biologic use in your moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis patients?
How likely are you to recommend biologic therapy to a colleague treating moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis?
questions.instruction: 0 = Not at all likely, 10 = Extremely likely
